description: Per media type, rate = the mean of its tracks' Bytes/Milliseconds ratios; among media types above the unweighted mean rate, report the average rate, average track count, and average excess.

b.request: For each media type with a name and at least one track with a non-null Bytes/Milliseconds ratio, calculate its rate as the mean of its tracks’ Bytes/Milliseconds ratios; select media types whose rate exceeds the unweighted mean of those media-type rates, then return one unrounded row with the selected media types’ average rate, average track count, and average amount by which their rates exceed that overall mean
b.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE m.Name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId HAVING COUNT(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) > 0), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(r.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(r.rate - o.mean_rate) AS average_excess FROM media_rates AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.rate > o.mean_rate

c.request: Consider only the media types (by name, counting only tracks that have a media type) whose bytes-per-millisecond rate is above the simple average of that rate across all media types. In one unrounded row, what are their average rate, their average number of tracks, and their average margin above that overall average? Per media type, rate = the mean of its tracks' Bytes/Milliseconds ratios; among media types above the unweighted mean rate, report the average rate, average track count, and average excess.
c.sql: WITH media_type_rates AS (SELECT m.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM media_type_rates) SELECT AVG(m.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(m.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(m.rate - o.average_rate) AS average_excess FROM media_type_rates AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.rate > o.average_rate

a.request: For each media type (grouped by name, using only tracks linked to a media type), compute its byte rate as the average of each track's `Bytes` divided by that track's `Milliseconds` (tracks with no size ignored), and count its tracks. Take the simple average of these rates across all media types, and keep only the media types whose rate is above it. Across those media types, return one row giving the average of their rates, the average of their track counts, and the average amount by which their rate exceeds the overall average, without rounding.
a.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT mt.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS byte_rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM MediaType AS mt JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS overall_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(m.track_count) AS avg_track_count, AVG(m.byte_rate - o.overall_rate) AS avg_excess_rate FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.byte_rate > o.overall_rate

d.request: For each named media type, using only tracks with a media type, calculate the mean of its tracks’ Bytes/Milliseconds ratios. Select the media types whose rates exceed the unweighted mean rate across all media types. In one unrounded row, report the selected media types’ average rate, average track count, and average amount by which their rates exceed the overall mean.
d.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE m.Name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(m.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(m.rate - o.mean_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.rate > o.mean_rate;
